name: A — Flagship "No Compromise" (modded MC + shaders + Distant Horizons at 1440p/4K)
target: Heavily modded Minecraft (Fabric/NeoForge 1.21.x + 26.x packs), Iris shaders, Distant Horizons, 128x resource packs, on Bazzite

cpu.name: AMD Ryzen 7 9850X3D
cpu.why: Fastest Minecraft CPU money can buy: 96 MB 3D V-Cache + 5.6 GHz boost. Minecraft's tick/render loop is single-thread + cache-bound, so this is the single highest-impact part in the build.

cooler.name: Arctic Liquid Freezer III Pro 360
cooler.why: 9850X3D pulls ~106 W in games and boosts on temperature; a 360 AIO keeps clocks pinned and is near-silent on a 120 W chip.

motherboard.name: MSI MAG X870 Tomahawk WiFi
motherboard.why: Strong VRM for an X3D chip, PCIe 5.0 x16 + PCIe 5.0 M.2, 2.5G LAN + WiFi 7, and mature Linux support (Intel/Realtek NICs and MediaTek/Qualcomm WiFi are well covered by in-kernel drivers).

memory.name: 64 GB (2x32 GB) DDR5-6000 CL30 EXPO
memory.why: DDR5-6000 CL30 is the AM5 1:1 sweet spot. 2 sticks only (4 DIMMs on AM5 forces ~4800-5200 MT/s and adds latency, which hurts Minecraft). 64 GB covers a 12-16 GB modpack heap + Bazzite + browser + shader compile spikes.

gpu.name: AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT 16 GB
gpu.why: Best Minecraft-shader performance per dollar in the Nov-2026 market, 16 GB VRAM for 128x packs + Distant Horizons, and the best-behaved GPU on Bazzite (RADV/Mesa; ~92% of Windows perf vs NVIDIA's regression).

storage.name: WD_BLACK SN850X 2 TB NVMe
storage.why: Modpack instances are tens of GB and churn thousands of small files; a DRAM-cached Gen4 drive cuts world-load and chunk-generation stalls. Add a second 2 TB drive later for a separate instance library.

psu.name: MSI MPG A1000GS 1000 W (ATX 3.1, 80+ Gold)
psu.why: 1000 W gives ~90% headroom over this build's ~530 W peak, runs in its efficiency band, and leaves room for a 600 W-class GPU upgrade.

case.name: Lian Li Lancool 217
case.why: Five included fans, top-tier thermals in 2026 round-ups, 380 mm GPU clearance and room for a 360 mm radiator up top. No proprietary RGB software is required (matters on Bazzite — OpenRGB covers it).

monitor.name: MSI MAG 272QP X24 27" 1440p 240 Hz QD-OLED
monitor.why: Minecraft with shaders is a motion-heavy, dark-scene-heavy game: OLED contrast + 240 Hz makes shader packs look dramatically better than a 60 Hz IPS, and 1440p keeps VRAM in check.
